title: Data health centre
decision: The Data Health route now inventories price, FX, holdings, fundamentals, news, macro, forecast and backtest stores with explicit missing, stale, corrupt, schema-mismatch and unavailable states. Responsive evidence rows expose path, row count, as-of date, freshness, provider, checksum, last success, last failure and warnings; the Dashboard shows the deterministic data-health summary; focused tests, CSV export, final package smoke and Playwright visual checks passed.
limitations: Flet semantic DOM snapshots expose only the accessibility toggle; Playwright visual and local HTTP fallback evidence is used for this canvas-rendered page.
The Computer Use retry stopped before input because it could not determine Chrome's current URL with enough confidence; this is recorded as a limitation, not a pass.
Data Health reports current local-store state and never invents missing provider or model data.
